author: 9twelve
what_it_is: Start with 250,000 cr. along with a new signature black Formula Gran Turismo car in garage! The car was just won after completing 100% before, then traded over to a new save, and was never driven.

gamefaqs.section: PlayStation 2 PS3 Virtual Memory Card Save (ZIP) (North America)

format: a raw PS2 memory card image, 8650752 bytes (8 MiB, 512-byte pages with 16-byte ECC spares), 'Sony PS2 Memory Card Format 1.2.0.0', one save (BASCUS-97328GAMEDATA, 4 files); the 8 bytes at 0x210 are a2f11807e2f9ab08, which PCSX2's file memory card (and its forks) writes when it closes a card

title: GRAN TURISMO 4
Game data
save.times: as the file stores them (PS2 card times, JST)

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/ps2-card.py 'GT4-start[1].ps2' -o OUT: reads the save with mymcplus 3.0.5 and writes OUT/Mcd001.ps2 (an 8 MiB card with ECC, the input card as is) for lrps2/pcee2/pcsx2, and OUT/mc0/<folder>/ for Play!

converted.read_back: work/ps2/tools/mcfs.py lists every file with the size and SHA-1 put on the card; one-saves (1saves convert + inspect) reads the card and finds BASCUS-97328GAMEDATA
converted.timestamps: what the save does not date is 2000-01-01 00:00:00 (JST, as a card stores it); the card's own root entries too
